title: DecisionPivot: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Decision Models in LLM Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.28522v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decision models support routing, guardrails, and output verification in LLM systems. However, item accuracy alone cannot establish whether models make correct decisions across controlled variations or assign reliable confidence to their predictions. We introduce DecisionPivot, a diagnostic benchmark comprising 48 tasks and 40,033 items across seven decision roles. Its core track contains 7,800 items from 13 generated task families, organized into contrast groups with computed answers verified by independently implemented solvers. The complementary reference track contains 32,233 items from 35 public test sets, preserving their original evaluation metrics. We evaluate 40 decision models and 14 general models using documented, model-specific protocols, assessing item and contrast-group accuracy, probability ordering, calibration, and empirical selective coverage. Our results reveal substantial differences obscured by aggregate scores: two

translated_title: DecisionPivot：LLM系统中决策模型的诊断基准
translated_abstract: 决策模型在LLM系统中承担着路由、护栏和输出验证的功能。然而，仅凭单项准确率无法确定模型是否能在受控变化下做出正确决策，或为其预测赋予可靠的置信度。我们提出了DecisionPivot，这是一个包含48个任务、40,033个项目、涵盖七种决策角色的诊断基准。其核心赛道包含来自13个生成任务族的7,800个项目，这些项目被组织成对比组，其计算答案由独立实现的求解器进行验证。互补的参考赛道包含来自35个公开测试集的32,233个项目，并保留其原始评估指标。我们使用有据可查的、针对模型的专用协议评估了40个决策模型和14个通用模型，考察单项与对比组准确率、概率排序、校准以及经验选择性覆盖率。我们的结果揭示了被聚合分数所掩盖的显著差异：两个（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: DecisionPivot是一个涵盖七种决策角色、包含48个任务和40,033个项目的诊断基准，通过由独立求解器验证的对比组以及准确率、概率排序、校准和选择性覆盖率等多维评估，系统性地揭示了被聚合分数掩盖的LLM决策模型在受控变化下决策正确性与置信度可靠性上的显著差异。
en_tdlr: DecisionPivot is a diagnostic benchmark spanning seven decision roles with 48 tasks and 40,033 items that uses solver-verified contrast groups and multi-dimensional evaluations—accuracy, probability ordering, calibration, and selective coverage—to reveal substantial model differences obscured by aggregate scores in LLM decision-making systems.
